'''Sunnim''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Baasen Ray]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sunnim followed his boss when Ray joined forces with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to help the latter prevent the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from obtaining the [[hyperspace nullifier]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] designed by the extinct [[K'kybak]] on the planet [[Seymarti V]]. Sunnim, however, was killed when he was stung in the throat by a beautiful deadly [[Butterfly/Legends|butterfly]] creature native to the planet.
